items.t: PCV valve cover failure causes oil burning and vacuum leaks
items.job: Replace valve cover with built-in PCV valve
items.note: If the intake manifold PCV part has also failed, it adds parts and about an hour of labor.

items.t: Coolant leaks from water pump, housings and reservoir
items.job: Replace water pump (most common coolant leak source)
items.note: GM coverage may pay for some leaks; check your VIN. A leaking thermostat housing or reservoir alone costs less.

items.t: Loose negative battery cable causes warning messages
items.job: Replace negative battery cable
items.note: GM special coverage may pay for this. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Turbocharger underboost and wastegate problems
items.job: Replace turbocharger
items.note: A vacuum or boost leak is often the real cause and costs far less, so test for leaks first.

items.t: Ignition coil failure and misfires
items.job: Replace ignition coil pack and spark plugs
items.note: If misfires keep returning, check the PCV valve cover too.

items.t: Timing belt must be replaced on schedule
items.job: Replace timing belt, tensioner and idler pulley
items.note: If the belt already broke, valves may be bent and the cost rises a lot.

items.t: 6T40 automatic hard shifting, loss of reverse or failure
items.job: Rebuild 6T40 automatic transmission
items.note: A leaking cooler line or a converter fix costs much less. A used transmission is cheaper but riskier.

items.t: Electric power steering sticks or feels notchy
items.job: Replace electric power steering gear assembly
items.note: GM special coverage may pay for this. Check your VIN. Test the battery cable first.

items.t: Steering wheel or steering shaft not fully secured (recalls)
items.job: Inspect and secure steering wheel and intermediate shaft
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Shifter may show Park when not in Park (recall)
items.job: Inspect and adjust shift linkage
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Spilled oil can catch fire on the engine shield (recall)
items.job: Modify engine shield to keep oil off it
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Fuel tank strap brackets missing welds (recall)
items.job: Add fasteners to fuel tank strap brackets
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Intermittent loss of power brake assist (recall)
items.job: Replace microswitch in brake booster vacuum pipe
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Driver airbag may not deploy (recalls)
items.job: Replace steering wheel airbag coil
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Driver airbag inflator may be the wrong part (recall)
items.job: Replace driver front airbag module
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Right front axle shaft can break (recalls)
items.job: Replace right front axle half shaft
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Engine block heater cord can crack in the cold (recall)
items.job: Replace engine block heater cord
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Shift cable can disconnect from the shifter (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace shift cable adjuster
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Inner tie rod may separate (recall)
items.job: Replace steering gear assembly
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Roof-rail side airbag inflator may rupture (recalls)
items.job: Replace roof-rail side airbag module
items.note: Price is per side. Free under GM recall, so check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Parking brake may not hold (recall)
items.job: Inspect and tighten rear parking brake bracket bolts
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Key can come out when not in Park (recall)
items.job: Replace ignition key cylinder lock housing
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Clogged PCV passage causes oil leaks and code P1101
items.job: Replace camshaft cover with updated PCV design
items.note: Fix the ventilation first. Resealing gaskets that leaked from pressure adds more labor.

items.t: Coolant leaks from hoses and expansion tank
items.job: Replace leaking coolant hose or expansion tank
items.note: If the water pump is the source, expect more. Overheating damage costs much more.

items.t: Cracked pistons
items.job: Replace pistons and rings (engine overhaul)
items.note: Some owners replace the whole engine instead, which can cost more.

items.t: Rear brake caliper piston can reduce braking (recall)
items.job: Bleed the brake system (recall)
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Start/stop accumulator cover may leak fluid (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace transmission start/stop accumulator
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN. If the transmission ran low on fluid, damage may cost much more.
